text: Decode JSON with a bounded integer hook that rejects overlong numeric lexemes before Python converts them.
rationale: Prevents huge-integer ValueError and keeps failures inside the UsageError boundary.

text: Preflight braces and brackets with a tiny depth counter before invoking json.load.
rationale: Turns pathological nesting into a controlled refusal instead of RecursionError.

text: Serialize reports through a UTF-8 backslash-replacing sink for lone surrogates.
rationale: Preserves CLI completion when receipt text contains invalid Unicode scalar values.

text: Convert parser diagnostics to filename plus line/column, discarding JSONDecodeError’s excerpt.
Reserve output capacity by encoding the complete report first and refusing before any partial write.
rationale: Makes the output cap deterministic and avoids truncated JSON.

text: Read capped inputs through a byte budget that stops exactly at the first excess byte.
rationale: Keeps manifest and receipt size failures predictable without loading unbounded data.
